typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Enclosure as string,
		{Period Start} as date,
		{Temperature - MAX (F)} as double,
		{Temperature - MIN (F)} as double,
		{Temperature - AVG (F)} as double,
		{Temperature - MAX ROC (F)} as double,
		{Humidity - MAX (%)} as double,
		{Humidity - MIN (%)} as double,
		{Humidity - AVG (%)} as double,
		{Humidity - MAX ROC (%)} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		TemperatureMIN as double,
		TemperatureAVG as double,
		HumidityMAXROC as double,
		PeriodStart as string,
		HumidityMIN as double,
		HumidityAVG as double,
		TemperatureMAXROC as double,
		HumidityMAX as double,
		Enclosure as string,
		TemperatureMAX as double,
		FName as string,
		EtlUser as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		TemperatureMIN = {Temperature - MIN (F)},
		TemperatureAVG = {Temperature - AVG (F)},
		HumidityMAXROC = {Humidity - MAX ROC (%)},
		PeriodStart = {Period Start},
		HumidityMIN = {Humidity - MIN (%)},
		HumidityAVG = {Humidity - AVG (%)},
		TemperatureMAXROC = {Temperature - MAX ROC (F)},
		HumidityMAX = {Humidity - MAX (%)},
		Enclosure,
		TemperatureMAX = {Temperature - MAX (F)},
		FName,
		EtlUser),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
